title: 第15章 被林陌征服的上官无情第16章 女魔头召见两个人一百个心眼
content_zh:
上官无情妖娆妩媚一笑，那看向林陌的美眸中，充满了一股迫切的期待之色。
跟平时那个英姿飒爽、锐气逼人的执法堂朱雀分队队长上官无情相比，简直就是判若两人。
林陌倒还真听说过一种说法。
据说，一个女人正不正经，与性格无关。
哪怕是平时看上去安静、温柔、矜持的淑女，在私底下和喜欢的人待在一起时，所表现出来的浪荡和主动。
简直可以刷新你对她的认知。
所以，眼下的上官无情表现得如此的急不可耐，也是有说法的。
见林陌磨磨唧唧的，急不可耐的上官无情一把将林陌推倒在床上，便准备霸王硬上弓。
犹如瓮中之鳖的林陌也放弃了抵抗，任由上官无情糟蹋。
在此之前，林陌完全没想到，他竟然也会有这么一天。
这也就是在魔门宗派的初圣宗才可能发生的事情，若是在仙道门派，即使有先天圣体加持，仙道门道的仙子，估计也不会表现得像上官无情这样的急不可耐。
不管怎么样。
因为纯阳圣体的存在。
至少当下的林陌，还是挺享受的。
当上官无情迫不及待的与其合二为一时，林陌体内的阴阳邪魔开始悄然运转，贪婪地攫取着上官无情的阴气。
而在上官无情不知不觉间，来自林陌身上的炽烈阳气，亦在对其进行反哺。
虽说上官无情所修行的功法并非阴阳邪魔功。
但纯阳圣体，对世上所有的女修而言，都相当于十全大补丸。
纯阳圣体的阳气，对女修不仅有美容养颜、强身健体的功效。
甚至那些炙热而不暴躁的雄浑阳气，还能在无形间使得女修的修为水涨船高。

这也是为什么，纯阳圣体对世间女修，有着如此巨大诱惑力的主要原因。
......
不知过了多久，直到外面的天色都暗下来了。
逐渐有点顶不住林陌攻势的上官无情，这才主动结束了这场激烈万分的鏖战。
上官无情眼神迷离，脸色通红。
心满意足，又感到不可思议道：“老家伙，你的战斗力还挺出人意料的嘛。”
无论是身体素质还是状态。
按理说她都应该是碾压林默的才对。
可事实居然是她顶不住林陌的攻势！
这就让上官无情感到不可思议的同时，也满足了她的生理需求。
林陌只是呵呵一笑，没有说什么。
开玩笑。
content_en:
Shangguan Qingqing smiled charmingly, and his beautiful eyes looking at Lin Mo were filled with eager anticipation.
Compared with Shangguan Wuqing, the usually heroic and energetic captain of the Suzaku detachment of the Law Enforcement Hall, he is a completely different person.
Lin Mo actually heard of a saying.
It is said that whether a woman is upright or not has nothing to do with her character.
Even a lady who usually looks quiet, gentle, and reserved shows how dissolute and proactive she is when she is with the person she likes in private.
It can simply refresh your understanding of her.
Therefore, there is a reason why Shangguan Ruqing is so impatient right now.
Seeing Lin Mo grinding and chirping, the impatient Shangguan pushed Lin Mo down on the bed ruthlessly, and then prepared to use the bow forcefully.
Lin Mo, who was like a turtle in a urn, also gave up resistance and allowed Shangguan to ruthlessly destroy him.
Before this, Lin Mo never thought that he would have such a day.
This is what can only happen in the First Saint Sect of the Demon Sect. If it were in the Immortal Sect, even with the blessing of the Innate Holy Body, the fairies of the Immortal Sect would probably not behave as impatiently as Shangguan Wuqing.
No matter what.
Because of the existence of the Pure Yang Holy Body.
At least Lin Mo was enjoying himself at the moment.
When Shangguan Wuqing couldn't wait to become one with him, the yin and yang demons in Lin Mo's body began to circulate quietly, greedily grabbing Shangguan Wuqing's yin energy.
And without Shangguan Qingqing knowing it, the blazing yang energy from Lin Mo's body was also feeding him back.
Although the skills practiced by Shangguan Wuqing are not Yin and Yang demon skills.
But the Pure Yang Holy Body is equivalent to the Shiquan Dabu Pill for all female cultivators in the world.
The yang energy of the pure yang holy body not only has the effect of beautifying and strengthening the body for female cultivators.
Even those powerful Yang energy that is hot but not irritable can invisibly make the female cultivator's cultivation level rise.
This is also the main reason why the Pure Yang Holy Body has such a huge allure to female cultivators in the world.
...
I don't know how long it took until the sky outside became dark.
Shangguan Wuqing, who gradually couldn't withstand Lin Mo's offensive, took the initiative to end this fierce and fierce battle.
Shangguan Wuqing's eyes were blurred and his face was red.
Satisfied, he felt incredible and said: "Old guy, your fighting ability is quite unexpected."
Whether it's physical fitness or state.
Logically speaking, she should be the one to crush Lin Mo.
But the fact was that she couldn't withstand Lin Mo's offensive!
This made Shangguan Wuqing feel incredible and at the same time satisfied her physiological needs.
Lin Mo just smiled and said nothing.
joke.
